# 4.1-III 教學資源彙整

## 數據來源（data_card.json）
1. **WHO – Climate change and health** — https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/climate-change-and-health（dp1、dp2、dp5）
2. **NASA Climate Vital Signs – Global Temperature** — https://climate.nasa.gov/vital-signs/global-temperature/（dp4）
3. **TCCIP 臺灣氣候變遷推估資訊與調適知識平台** — https://tccip.ncdr.nat.gov.tw/（dp3）
4. **MOE RAG 0180_CCE 氣候變遷與疾病** — 心理健康影響（dp6）

## map.csv 資源
- **Public Health Heats Up**：https://snr.unl.edu/download/research/projects/climateimpacts/roundtable2015/PPT-PublicHealthHeatsUp-Khan-10072015.pdf
- **Why should we care about climate change?（LMU）**：https://academics.lmu.edu/media/lmuacademics/cures/urbanecolab/module03/M3_L3_T_Final.pdf
- **Mapping climate change and health into the medical curriculum**：https://assets.nationbuilder.com/docsenvaus/pages/377/attachments/original/1708559288/Climate-Change-and-Health-Curriculum-Key-Points-blue.pptx

## MOE RAG 教案
- 0272_CCE_IV 維生基礎系統（臺灣氣候脆弱度與複合災害風險）
- 0180_CCE 氣候變遷與疾病（心理健康、氣候疾病）
- 0149_CCE Heal the world（中山國小環境變遷模組）

## 延伸閱讀
- IPCC AR6 WGII Summary for Policymakers（教師備課）
- UNICEF Children's Climate Risk Index（全球兒童氣候風險）
